name: local-project-workspace
description: Safely read, search, edit, test, and review explicitly allowed local projects through MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Work safely with explicitly allowed local project folders.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT or Codex to selected local projects through a safety-scoped MCP server. Read and search files, apply hash-guarded patches, run allowlisted tasks, and review Git changes without exposing an arbitrary shell.
defaultPrompt: List the local projects I have authorized.
Inspect a project, make the requested change, run its tests, and show the diff.
